title: Latency Spike in Recommendation Service Degrading Checkout
description: P99 latency spiked from 45ms to 4,200ms on recommendationservice. Multiple frontend timeouts observed during product page loads. CPU utilization on Redis recommendation cache elevated.
ground_truth_summary: PR #412 reduced Redis recommendation cache TTL from 300s to 5s, creating a cache-stampede storm against the downstream catalog store.
decoy_summary: PR #409 ('productcatalog: optimize caching layer and query TTL') sounds identical semantically, but was merged 3 days prior without incident.
coincident_deploy_summary: Deploy of adservice:v1.4.2 happened 3 minutes before the alert, but adservice has no causal dependency path to recommendationservice.

title: Cascading Checkout 500 Outage on Order Finalization
description: HTTP 500 rate on checkoutservice surged to 38.4%. Users unable to complete purchases. Checkout pods reporting context deadline exceeded on downstream gRPC calls.
ground_truth_summary: PR #521 introduced strict currency validation with a blocking 1500ms external fraud check API timeout in paymentservice.
decoy_summary: PR #518 ('checkoutservice: improve checkout button click tracking and UI error banners') matches 'checkout error' semantic search, but only touched frontend telemetry.
coincident_deploy_summary: Deploy of cartservice:v2.1.0 happened 7 minutes prior, but logs show healthy cart reads/writes.

title: Cart Service Redis Connection Exhaustion & CrashLoopBackOff
description: cartservice pods repeatedly restarting with OOMKilled and RedisConnectionException: Timeout waiting for connection from pool.
ground_truth_summary: PR #633 lowered redis max connection pool size from 100 to 5 per pod, leading to fast thread pool exhaustion and leak.
decoy_summary: Runbook RUNBOOK-CART-04 advises increasing pod RAM for memory leaks, but this runbook was superseded when cart migrated to external Redis pool.

title: Payment Gateway Timeout Outage (External Provider Incident)
description: paymentservice reporting 504 Gateway Timeouts across all credit card transaction authorizations. External Visa/Stripe endpoints unreachable.
ground_truth_summary: Major external payment provider regional network fiber outage. No internal code change or PR was responsible.
decoy_summary: PR #701 ('paymentservice: update payment retry policy and backoff parameters') was merged 14 days ago and was wrongly implicated by naive RAG.
coincident_deploy_summary: Routine doc bump deploy dep-pay-109 occurred 10 minutes prior.

title: Frontend CPU Saturation from Unindexed Product Catalog Query
description: frontend service experiencing high thread pool starvation, response latency climbing to 2.8s across all web routes.
ground_truth_summary: PR #815 in productcatalogservice added an unindexed nested SQL JOIN query on related items table, blocking upstream recommendation queries to frontend.
decoy_summary: PR #820 ('frontend: update hero promo banner') was merged 5 minutes AFTER the incident started. Naive RAG blamed it due to service name match.
